description: A jQuery plugin for managing 2-level checkbox hierarchies with parent-child relationships, event delegation, and styling support.

methods.name: multicheckboxcondition
methods.description: Installs parent-child checkbox behavior with condition support, suitable for large checkbox groups.

methods.name: multicheckbox
methods.description: Sets up parent-child checkbox behavior for a single parent checkbox and its children.

methods.name: multicheckboxes
methods.description: Uses event delegation to manage checkbox hierarchies within a container, supporting row styling and select-all.
